comment: Typed-mode evaluation (2026-09-28). One task = one UI change = one typed recording with one gesture and one note. `note` is what the user types into Pointcast's note box (variants B and C); `intent` is what the independent writer of variant A is told the developer wants, next to a screenshot with the element outlined. Ground truth (files/target/lines/wrong, the grade.mjs rules) was fixed before any agent run. `kind` is recorded in the results: repeated = the same label or structure appears more than once; shared = the element is rendered by a shared component or parent template; data = the visible value lives in data, a view or a locale file, not in the markup; plain = none of these.
